---
title: "Geopolitics and Climate Change"
format: html
---

## Objectives
- Discuss de-globalization and supply chain diversification.  
- Evaluate WTO reform and multilateral-ism.  
- Analyze climate change as a global economic challenge.  
- Identify opportunities in green growth strategies. 

## Key Concepts
- Supply chain security.  
- Multilateral vs bilateral trade strategies. 
- Climate economics and externalities.
